label: Hard budget ceiling, no splurge allowance
catches: Cost drift. The owner profile permits one splurge meal per city, so it cannot detect a prompt edit that raises suggested costs across the board. This one has no splurge clause at all.

answers.budgetStyle: Strict daily cap. Street food and free public sights only; no paid tours, no splurge meals, nothing over $15 a head

profile.aboutMe: Backpacking on a fixed daily budget. Eats where locals queue, walks everywhere, and treats any paid admission as a real decision. Would rather see four free things than one ticketed one.
